observations: Fine4px ADC bands differ subtly among full/pre-head/pooled methods. The dark high-noise8px carrier remains largely absent even in both pre-head outputs; the brighter noisy carrier is faint in all. Pooling V91 does not visibly recover the missing dark carrier. Dark display exposure16 reveals residual slow texture but is shared across methods/noisy/GT. No photographic-quality inference or new model/policy promotion.
scope: All four predeclared cases and six methods, native160 pixels. Counterfactual pre-head path is jointly trained with the head; frozen pooling is not a retrained global model. Scalar and original-checkpoint replay accounting remain to be evaluated.
